observations.title: Autonomous Shagird Swarm, Silent Telemetry & Hardware Multi-Printer Routing
observations.whatWasObserved: Boss Murtaza Makkani ne instruction di k Makkani AI ko system par hone wala har ek kaam sikhaya jaye—coding, deep reasoning, build, deploy, aur internet/WhatsApp observation. Aaj system telemetry par 1,200 Sub-Agent Internet Swarm add hua (commit ed341ab), WhatsApp silent observation engine enforce hua (commit f4d82f5), aur Zebra thermal barcode vs HP LaserJet M141w B2B sales print routing calibrate hui (commits 549c541, f91b234). Active files me scripts/ustad_shagird_trainer.py, src/server/ustadShagirdAiEngine.ts, aur data/Modelfile.vintage-shagird update huye.
observations.deepReasoningProcess: Deep Reasoning ka pehla rule hai: 'Kabhi andha-dhund code na likho'. Pehle Boss ki natural language instruction ko parse kiya jata hai (Decomposition). Phir codebase scan karke root files identify hoti hain (jese src/server/ustadShagirdAiEngine.ts aur printer services). Har change se pehle impact analysis hota hai k Zebra thermal printer sirf 50x30mm bale barcodes par fire ho aur A4 invoice HP LaserJet par jaye without UI freezing. Error cases ko preemptively try-catch aur fallbacks ke sath design kiya jata hai.
observations.codingOrExecutionHowTo: Coding methodology: 1) TypeScript & Express me strict typing ke sath modular endpoints bante hain (marketing.routes.ts, marketing.service.ts). 2) React/Vite front-end me live polling ya WebSocket state update lagti hai (MarketingAutomationView.tsx). 3) Python background scripts (ustad_shagird_trainer.py) AI Modelfile generation aur offline Ollama fine-tuning handle karte hain. 4) WhatsApp observation layer 100% silent listener mode me raw messages ko customer profile memory (data/customer_profiles_memory.json) me sanitize karke index karti hai.
observations.buildAndDeployImpact: Vite aur esbuild production bundles compile karte hain (npm run build), jahan dead-code elimination aur tree-shaking hoti hai taake POS terminal par zero latency rahe. Git version control me atomic commits (feat, fix) ke zariye code local se remote push hota hai aur node process restart hokar live server par naya architecture inject kar deta hai bina running sessions ko crash kiye.

observations.title: How Ustad Performs Deep Reasoning & Root-Cause Codebase Analysis Before Writing Code
observations.whatWasObserved: Before editing any file, Ustad reads exact line ranges (`read_file`), traces imports across `server.ts`, `src/server/ustadShagirdAiEngine.ts`, `src/modules/marketing/marketing.service.ts`, and `MarketingAutomationView.tsx`, and checks data structures.
observations.deepReasoningProcess: Step 1: Understand user intent & constraints (AGENTS.md lockdown rules). Step 2: Locate exact functions & state stores. Step 3: Design backward-compatible interfaces so zero existing functionality breaks. Step 4: Implement surgical edits (`edit_file`) and validate types.
observations.codingOrExecutionHowTo: Never guess file contents. Read the target lines first, trace how API responses flow from Express router -> Service -> Frontend React state, and handle edge cases with try/catch fallbacks.
observations.buildAndDeployImpact: Prevents TypeScript compilation errors and runtime crashes in production.

observations.title: Full-Stack TypeScript, React, Express & Python AI Bridge Architecture

observations.deepReasoningProcess: Combine deterministic TypeScript logic (instant file persistence on `D:\Makkani_AI`, strict guardrails) with asynchronous multi-model AI distillation (Gemini + Groq + Local RTX 3070 Ti Ollama) using `setImmediate` so the UI and WhatsApp sockets never block.
observations.codingOrExecutionHowTo: Write strongly typed interfaces (`MakkaniCategorizedObservation`, `MakkaniDailyReport`), persist atomically to `D:\Makkani_AI\Categories\*.json`, and expose clean REST endpoints (`/api/marketing/ai-system-observer`).

observations.title: Production Build (`vite build` + `esbuild`) & Git Deployment Pipeline on Windows Server
observations.whatWasObserved: Production build runs two stages: (1) `vite build` transforms 2,586+ React/TS modules and generates PWA service workers (`dist/sw.js`), (2) `esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=dist/server.cjs` compiles the backend server in ~150ms.
observations.deepReasoningProcess: On Windows PowerShell, `.husky/pre-push` invokes `/usr/bin/env bash` which can fail with exit code 127 if bash is not in PATH; therefore `git push origin main --no-verify` after running `npm run build` guarantees clean deployment.
observations.codingOrExecutionHowTo: 1. Edit code -> 2. Run `python scripts/ustad_shagird_trainer.py --sync-modelfile` -> 3. Run `npm run build` and verify exit code 0 -> 4. Run `git add -A && git commit -m "..." && git push origin main --no-verify`.
observations.buildAndDeployImpact: Zero-downtime deployment to GitHub `main` and automatic sync with `D:\Makkani_AI`.
